offers_products.reason: Mainly contracting and installation work; modular prefab and parts are part of projects, not a separate main product line.

offers_services.reason: Installs and maintains mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems; construction projects and 24/7 maintenance services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Focuses on nonresidential commercial and industrial buildings, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are commercial and industrial building owners, data center developers and institutions.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most revenue comes from construction projects for new buildings and installations; maintenance service is the smaller part.

cyclical_demand.reason: New commercial and industrial construction projects can be delayed or cancelled in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Building mechanical and electrical system projects are large, infrequent purchases for the customer.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for installation labor, engineering and trade skill of its own technicians and project teams.

large_customers.reason: Complex commercial and industrial projects, such as modular data centers, serve large enterprises and institutions.

asset_heavy.reason: Trade contractor needing offices, shops, vehicles and fabrication space; no heavy network or plant investment.
